description: Client-side MCP server attestation verifier — public HTTP endpoint to check if an MCP server is BHC-S attested

fitness_assertions.description: POST /v1/trust/mcp/verify {url:'https://agentlair.dev'} returns 200, raw_descriptor is non-null with issuer=https://agentlair.dev, errors mentions 'attestation token' (issuer discovery — self-attestation deferred)
fitness_assertions.method: curl -s -X POST https://agentlair.dev/v1/trust/mcp/verify -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"url":"https://agentlair.dev"}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); assert r['verified']==False, r; assert r['raw_descriptor'] is not None, r; assert r['raw_descriptor'].get('issuer')=='https://agentlair.dev', r; assert any('attestation token' in e for e in r['errors']), r; print('ok')"

fitness_assertions.description: POST {url:'http://10.0.0.1'} returns 400 with error 'private IP rejected'
Same URL twice within 5min: second response has X-Cache: HIT header
fitness_assertions.method: URL=https://agentlair.dev; curl -si -X POST https://agentlair.dev/v1/trust/mcp/verify -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"url\":\"$URL\"}" | grep X-Cache; curl -si -X POST https://agentlair.dev/v1/trust/mcp/verify -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"url\":\"$URL\"}" | grep X-Cache

fitness_assertions.description: All 200 responses have all 8 required fields: verified, server_id, issued_at, expires_at, jwks_url, bhc_token_type, raw_descriptor, errors
fitness_assertions.method: curl -s -X POST https://agentlair.dev/v1/trust/mcp/verify -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"url":"https://agentlair.dev"}' | jq 'has("verified") and has("server_id") and has("issued_at") and has("expires_at") and has("jwks_url") and has("bhc_token_type") and has("raw_descriptor") and has("errors")'
